name: Fencamfamin
summary: Fencamfamin (INN), also known as fencamfamine or by the brand names Glucoenergan and Reactivan, is a stimulant which was developed by Merck in the 1960s.

uses.text: Fencamfamin is still used, though rarely, for treating depressive day-time fatigue, lack of concentration and lethargy, particularly in individuals who have chronic medical conditions, as its favourable safety profile makes it the most suitable drug in some cases.
uses.brands: Reactivan, Glucoenergan (E. Merck);, Norcamphane, Euvitol (Allen & Hanburys), Euvital, Reactimerk, Altimina, Entigue, Sicoclor

sideEffects.text: Fencamfamin is well tolerated and causes minimal circulatory effects. Extended use may result in a dryness of the mouth.
